ruleBookInfo.kind:
<js>
function fqObj(raw) {
  var s = (typeof raw === 'string') ? raw : String(raw);
  try { var o = JSON.parse(s); if (o && o.data) return o.data; } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}
function fqHtml(raw, key) {
  var s = (typeof raw === 'string') ? raw : String(raw);
  var m = s.match(new RegExp('"' + key + '":\\s*"((?:[^"\\\\]|\\\\.)*)"'));
  return m ? m[1].replace(/\\u002F/g, '/').replace(/\\\//g, '/').replace(/\\"/g, '"') : '';
}
var d = fqObj(result);
var ks = [];
if (d) {
  try {
    var arr = JSON.parse(d.categoryV2 || '[]');
    for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { if (arr[i] && arr[i].Name) ks.push(arr[i].Name); }
  } catch (e) {}
  if (!ks.length && d.completeCategory) ks.push(String(d.completeCategory).replace(/\//g, ','));
  ks.push(String(d.creationStatus) === '1' ? '连载' : '完结');
} else {
  var cat = fqHtml(result, 'category');
  if (cat) ks.push(cat.replace(/\//g, ','));
  var st = (String(result).match(/"status":\s*(\d+)/) || [])[1];
  ks.push(st === '1' ? '连载' : '完结');
}
ks.join(',');
</js>
